stem:
Rekha hangs a small stone from a thread to make a simple pendulum. She pulls the stone aside and lets it swing freely.

Which motion of the stone is one complete oscillation?

options.text: The stone moves from the mean position to one extreme position.
The stone moves from the mean position to one extreme position and back to the mean position.
The stone cannot complete an oscillation if counting starts at an extreme position.
The stone moves from the mean position to one extreme position, then to the other extreme position, and back to the mean position.

teacher.key_rationale: One oscillation is mean → one extreme → other extreme → mean. Stopping after one extreme, returning after only one extreme, or denying completion when the count starts at an extreme are incomplete or narrowed counts.
